name: The film, rough cut A
title: The film, rough cut, spotlight overlays
story: The whole film in the spotlight style: the hero frame and its three points, the split, the rewind to Monday, the plan filling the board, a merge approved by hand, the dial at full auto, the supervisor after a stall, a question only Sebastian answers, the delivery metrics, the sandbox from inside a card, and the closing line. Captions only, no voice.
